title: Trend arrow on wear (SW3) does not budge
symptom: No matter how steep the delta, the trend arrow on both the xDrip watchface and the xDrip large watchface on a Sony SW3 remains level.
evidence_quote: No matter how steep the delta, the trend arrow on both the xDrip watchface and the xDrip large watchface on my Sony SW3 remains level.
